department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Applications by 12/01/2026 get guaranteed review; later ones are reviewed as space and funding allow until 02/25/2027.
deadline.quote: These are the application deadlines for applicants who wish to begin their graduate studies in fall 2027. | Electrical and Computer Engineering 12/01/2026

funding.value: Department states PhD research is fully funded with guaranteed pay for the first five years.
funding.quote: PhD research at Duke is fully funded | Guaranteed pay, 12 months a year, for the first five years
